Subject: TideWave AP onboarding — preferred invoice channel and sample invoice for PO stamping

Hi Samantha —

Congrats on the go-live next week. Quick question to close out our activation checklist: what is TideWave's preferred invoice submission channel once we start sending POs? Two things we need to confirm from your side:

- Do you prefer our portal (recommended for tracking & automatic PO matching) or should we keep email as the primary intake (accounts-payable@tidewavehealth.com)?
- If email is used as a fallback, what subject line tokens or PO placement do your AP systems require so our invoices auto-match? (e.g., PO in subject vs PO on first line of PDF)

Attached is the fillable AP onboarding form and a sample invoice layout we use (PDF). If portal, do you need a SFTP or API push for PDF/CSV? If email, I want to confirm acceptable filename conventions and whether you need an embedded PO field.

Can you also confirm any VAT / tax ID lines we should include for US invoices?

If easier, we can schedule a 20-min handoff with your AP team.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@tidewavehealth.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: TideWave AP onboarding — preferred invoice channel and sample invoice for PO stamping

Hi Ben —

Thanks — great timing as we finalize our onboarding. Short answers:

- Portal first: We prefer suppliers to upload invoices to our vendor portal (Vendors.TideWaveHealth.com). Portal uploads give the fastest processing and auto-apply to POs.
- Email fallback: We accept invoices via accounts-payable@tidewavehealth.com when portal is down or for legacy suppliers. For email, please put the PO number in the subject (PO:<PONUMBER>) and include the PO as the first visible line in the PDF body. Example subject: "PO:12345678 — Redwood Inference invoice".
- File format: PDF preferred. If sending CSV, include a header row with columns: invoice_number, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, tax_amount, total.
- VAT/Tax: For US entities, include our Fed Tax ID: 12-3456789 on the remittance section; for non-US, include VAT ID in the header.

We do have a quick onboarding checklist on the portal page (I attached the AP intake guide). If you want, I can invite our AP lead (ap-ops@tidewavehealth.com) to the thread for any technical questions (SFTP credentials, API key).

Samantha Ortiz
Director, Finance Operations
TideWave Health
